City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 23, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:43 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office (Call-In)

  Staff Present:  Damian Pipkins, Housing Section 8
  Micah Herd, Ana Ma, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of November 09, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. It’s Your Party Floral & Event Design – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  material and labor for Halloween Spooktacular for Parks and Recreation in the amount of
  $3,283.50. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Integra Realty Resources – Los Angeles Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment
  for the appraisal services for a vacant lot in the amount of $1,028.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. County Hills Animal Clinic – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  veterinary services for the Inglewood Police Department in the amount of $5,134.65. Motion
  carried unanimously.

5. Grand Prix Auto Body – Item pulled.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 12:08 a.m. Adjournment
